verdict.rationale: three.js is itself the official JavaScript library, published as the `three` npm package (v0.186.0, MIT, about 12M weekly downloads). It comes with first-party API docs, examples, a migration guide, and machine-readable llms.txt and llms-full.txt files that coding agents use to drive it directly. Missing for 10: first-party TypeScript typings (community @types/three has signature mismatches the maintainer won't maintain), and official SDKs or bindings beyond JavaScript.
